budget_caveat: the policy is the archived one and is not recalibrated, so under the new dynamics it no longer spends exactly the declared budget: the altitude history it reads is not the gravity-only history it was calibrated on. The realized budget is reported per orbit rather than corrected, because recalibrating would change the policy and this campaign is a replication of a policy, not of a budget

budget_parity_subgroup.status: post_hoc; specified after the realized budgets were seen
budget_parity_subgroup.rule: |realized beta - 1.00| <= 10% of the declared budget, on the orbits resolved under both dynamics
